author: Antonialock
body:
I think this comes from pho84 and pho842 (GOA is still out of sync with UniProt website so I can't see the underlying rule for sure)

these two genes are annotated to vacuole from [pmid  ](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8294586/) https://www.pombase.org/reference/PMID:34147496

I think this is incorrect for GO - these genes are active at the plasma membrane, and are internalized to restrict phosphate uptake. If you remove those annotations I will also remove the from Swiss-Prot, and the ARBA inference on pho841 should disappear. Sounds ok?

author: Antonialock
body: . In WT, Pho84 and Pho842 on the plasma membrane are decreased by Pqr1 function upon −N to restrict phosphate uptake. The vacuole contains polyP at a normal level and is able to degrade autophagosomes. Without Pqr1, Pho84 and Pho842 remain on plasma membrane and incorporate too much phosphate, resulting in hyperaccumulation of polyP, which interferes with proper autophagy-dependent proteolysis.
